title: Jitsi Meet: free Zoom alternative
caption:
Zoom charges $14.16/month to host calls longer than 40 minutes. Jitsi Meet does it for free 📹

✅ HD video, screen sharing, chat and polls
✅ Guests join with a link, no account needed
✅ Free apps for iPhone and Android
✅ No subscription, no time limit, 100% free

💻 Any browser · iPhone · Android
ℹ️ On meet.jit.si the person who starts the meeting signs in with a Google, Facebook or GitHub account. Guests don't need one. Zoom's $14.16/month is Workplace Pro billed annually

Comment "CALL" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day
